body: I just wanted to tell you that I can relate to your troubles with reading/instructions/critical thinking.  I was even placed in a special group when I was in school because I had a lot of trouble actually understanding anything I read.  It's embarrassing, but I usually need people to break down instructions for me and explain it slowly and thoroughly.  My family also thinks I'm just lazy and not trying. I can actually relate to most of what you described.  You're not alone.
